title: 跟王爷爷学钓鱼
en: Learn to fish from Grandpa Wang
target: saying what you would like to learn; thanking an elder
curriculumStatus: Beginner prototype; HSK level mapping and native-speaker review pending

nodes.zh: 年轻人，你也喜欢钓鱼吗？
nodes.pinyin: Niánqīngrén, nǐ yě xǐhuan diàoyú ma?
nodes.en: Young one, do you like fishing too?
nodes.speaker: wang

prompt.en: Say you'd like to learn to fish.

nodes.zh: 好啊！这是鱼竿。把鱼钩放到水里，等鱼上钩。
nodes.pinyin: Hǎo a! Zhè shì yúgān. Bǎ yúgōu fàng dào shuǐ lǐ, děng yú shàng gōu.
nodes.en: Sure! Here's a rod. Put the hook in the water and wait for a bite.
nodes.speaker: wang
